images.title: Reading one bar
images.purpose: Show that the top of a bar, followed across to the side numbers, gives the count.
images.composition: One vertical bar with a plain vertical number line on its left and a dotted guide across.
images.exact_structure: A vertical number line on the left with 7 evenly spaced ticks for 0 to 6, only 0 and 5 written. One teal #0072B2 bar standing on the base line, exactly 5 units tall, labelled Class 2 under it. A dotted grey #6B7280 line runs from the bar top across to the tick 5, which is marked in reddish purple #CC79A7. Exactly 1 bar.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more than one bar, or uneven tick spacing
images.takeaway: Follow the top of the bar across to the number.
images.description: One teal bar for Class 2 that is 5 units tall, with a dotted line across to 5 on the side numbers.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to follow the dotted line from the top of the bar to the number.

image_decisions.why: Reading a bar against the side numbers is a picture idea; one bar is enough.
